issues.detail: The Hebrew 'עַיִשׁ' (Ayish, likely the constellation Ursa Major/Big Dipper) is rendered as 'sao Mai' (the Morning Star/Venus), which is a different celestial object. The Hebrew also has 'עַל בָּנֶיהָ' ('with its sons/children'), which the Vietnamese renders as 'cùng các con của nó' (with its children), but the name swap changes the referent.
